svg.text: ✈ on to Tbilisi, Day 184: Georgia, Armenia, then the Western Balkans; home ≈ Day 229
China 中国 + Central Asia 2027 (draft): follow the weather
Day 1 = Tue 23 Mar 2027 (arrival in Beijing) · Day 38–45: family week in Zigong 自贡 · then Georgia, Armenia + the Western Balkans, ✈ home ≈ Day 229 · ◆ = border crossing · faded = optional
How each leg is travelled
Flight
Train (mostly high-speed)
Bus / shared taxi
4×4 (Pamir Highway)
Land border crossing
Flights: Seattle → Beijing, Xining → Chengdu (Zigong),
Yibin or Chengdu → Lanzhou, Kashgar → Hailar,
Arxan → Urumqi, Urgench → Tashkent → Tbilisi. Everything
else by train, bus, shared taxi or 4×4.
China (Q2 visa, 90 days a stay): Day 1 → 66, 71 → 126.
Kazakhstan: QazETA needed from 1 July 2027.
Pamir: GBAO permit ($20, fixed entry date).
Tashkurgan: border-area permit, in person,
at the police exit-entry office in Kashgar.
Weather: 10-year normals (Open-Meteo for China,
NASA POWER for Central Asia).
Route order and stop lengths only;
beds and legs come next.
